import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static Map<Integer, Long> tab1_cache = new HashMap<>();
    static Map<String, Long> tab2_cache = new HashMap<>();

    public static long calc_num1(int x) {
        if (x < 0) {
            return 0;
        }
        if (x < 2) {
            return 1;
        }
        if (!tab1_cache.containsKey(x)) {
            long sum_result = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < x; j++) {
                sum_result += calc_num1(j) * calc_num1(x - 1 - j);
            }
            tab1_cache.put(x, sum_result);
        }
        return tab1_cache.get(x);
    }

    public static long calc_num2(int x, int y) {
        if (x < 0 || y <= 0 || x >= Math.pow(2, y - 1)) {
            return 0;
        }
        if (x < 2) {
            return 1;
        }
        if (x < y) {
            return calc_num1(x);
        }
        String key = x + "," + y;
        if (!tab2_cache.containsKey(key)) {
            long sum_result = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < x; j++) {
                sum_result += calc_num2(j, y - 1) * calc_num2(x - 1 - j, y - 1);
            }
            tab2_cache.put(key, sum_result);
        }
        return tab2_cache.get(key);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int a = scanner.nextInt();
        int b = scanner.nextInt();
        System.out.println(calc_num1(a) - calc_num2(a, b));
        scanner.close();
    }
}
